title: China stages record drills designed to encircle Taiwan
description: China launched its most extensive war games around Taiwan on Monday to showcase Beijing's ability to cut off the island from outside support in a conflict, as U.S. President Donald Trump downplayed the threat behind the drills.

Five designated zones will face air and sea restrictions.
